title: Businessfinder input
description: Search Google Maps for businesses, refine public business contact details, and optionally prepare or send outreach.

searchTerms.title: Business types
searchTerms.description: Use distinct business types, for example accountants and commercial cleaners.

location.title: Location
location.description: A town, city, county, or country. Keep the business type out of this field.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Maximum places per search term
maxResultsPerSearch.description: A hard cost and runtime limit for every search term.

enrichment.title: Contact refinement
enrichment.description: Only public business contact pages are read. Personal employee lead enrichment is not requested.

outreach.title: Outreach
outreach.description: Off by default. Prepare creates drafts in the dataset. Send also requires mailbox secrets and an explicit lawful-basis confirmation.
